scenicChapters.title: Mont Ventoux Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 1909 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Mont Ventoux Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: For 7 km this is Mont Ventoux Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

mont-ventoux-loop.story: Out of Bédoin and back again: 43 km, roughly 42 min in the saddle. The stops in between: Mont Ventoux summit, Sault and Gorges de la Nesque. The highest point is about 1,900 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
